title.en: Do You Know Your Kampala LC?

question.en: Can LC1 handle a criminal case?
question.sw: LC1 inaweza kushughulikia kesi ya jinai?

en: Yes, LC1 is a criminal court
No, LC1 only handles small civil matters
Only if the case involves land
Only if the police refer it
lg: Yee, LC1 kkooti ya misango gy'obubbi
Nedda, LC1 ekwata kwokka ensonga entono ez'obutonde
Kwokka singa omusango gukwatagana ne ttaka
sw: Ndiyo, LC1 ni mahakama ya jinai
Hapana, LC1 hushughulikia tu mambo madogo ya kimila

explanation.en: LC1 has civil jurisdiction only, under the Local Governments Act. Criminal cases go to the police and magistrates' courts.
explanation.lg: LC1 erina buyinza kwokka ku nsonga ez'obutonde, ng'etteeka ly'ebyalo bwe ligamba. Emisango gy'obubbi gigenda ku poliisi ne mu kkooti za magistrate.
explanation.sw: LC1 ina mamlaka ya kimila tu, chini ya Sheria za Serikali za Mitaa. Kesi za jinai huenda kwa polisi na mahakama za hakimu.

question.en: Who fixes potholes and collects garbage in Kampala?
question.lg: Ani addaabiriza ebinnya era ayonja kasasiro mu Kampala?
question.sw: Nani hutengeneza mashimo na kukusanya taka Kampala?

explanation.en: Roads, waste and city planning are KCCA's job under the KCCA Act 2010. Report on 0414-254-460.
explanation.lg: Enguudo, kasasiro n'enteekateeka y'ekibuga mulimu gwa KCCA ng'etteeka lya KCCA Act 2010 bwe ligamba. Tegeeza ku 0414-254-460.
explanation.sw: Barabara, taka na mipango ya jiji ni kazi ya KCCA chini ya KCCA Act 2010. Ripoti kwa 0414-254-460.

question.en: How much is the LC1 stamp on your document?
question.lg: Sitampu ya LC1 ku bbaluwa yo mmeka?
question.sw: Muhuri wa LC1 kwenye waraka wako ni pesa ngapi?

explanation.en: The LC1 stamp is a flat 10,000 UGX by law. Anyone charging a percentage is extorting you.
explanation.lg: Sitampu ya LC1 ya UGX 10,000 nnyiriri ng'etteeka bwe ligamba. Asaba ekitundu akutunza bubbi.
explanation.sw: Muhuri wa LC1 ni UGX 10,000 taslimu kisheria. Anayedai asilimia anakunyang'anya.

question.en: How much is the LC1 introductory letter?
question.lg: Ebbaluwa ya LC1 eya kwanjula mmeka?
question.sw: Barua ya utambulisho ya LC1 ni pesa ngapi?

explanation.en: The LC1 introductory letter is free by law everywhere in Uganda.
explanation.lg: Ebbaluwa ya LC1 eya kwanjula ya bwereere ng'etteeka bwe ligamba wonna mu Uganda.
explanation.sw: Barua ya utambulisho ya LC1 ni bure kisheria kote Uganda.

question.en: You disagree with an LC1 decision. What do you do?
question.lg: Tolikkiriziganya na nsalawo ya LC1. Okola otya?
question.sw: Hukubaliani na uamuzi wa LC1. Unafanya nini?

en: Pay the chairman to change it
sw: Kata rufaa kwa LC2 ndani ya siku 30

explanation.en: Appeals from LC1 go to LC2 within 30 days. Carry the written LC1 decision.
explanation.lg: Okujulira okuva ku LC1 kugenda ku LC2 mu nnaku 30. Twala ensalawo ya LC1 mu buwandiike.
explanation.sw: Rufaa kutoka LC1 huenda kwa LC2 ndani ya siku 30. Beba uamuzi ulioandikwa wa LC1.

title.en: Do You Know Your Mukono LC?

question.en: Where does a customary land boundary fight start?
question.lg: Entalo y'ensalo y'ettaka ery'obutonde etandikira wa?
question.sw: Mapigano ya mpaka ya ardhi ya kimila huanzia wapi?

explanation.en: Customary boundary disputes start at the LC1 Civil Court, not the police. Land Act Cap 227, Section 41.
explanation.lg: Enjawulo z'ensalo ez'obutonde zitandikira mu kkooti ya LC1, si ku poliisi. Land Act Cap 227, Section 41.
explanation.sw: Migogoro ya mipaka ya kimila huanzia Mahakama ya LC1, si polisi. Land Act Cap 227, Kifungu cha 41.

question.en: Where does a mailo land dispute go?
question.lg: Enjawulo y'ettaka lya mailo egenda wa?
question.sw: Mgogoro wa ardhi ya mailo huenda wapi?

explanation.en: Mailo and titled land go to the District Land Board. LC1 has no power there. Land Act Cap 227, Section 42.
explanation.lg: Ettaka lya mailo n'eririna title bigenda ku District Land Board. LC1 terina buyinza eyo. Land Act Cap 227, Section 42.
explanation.sw: Ardhi ya mailo na yenye hati huenda Bodi ya Ardhi ya Wilaya. LC1 haina mamlaka huko. Land Act Cap 227, Kifungu cha 42.

question.en: Can a widow be chased from the family home?
question.lg: Nnamwandu ayinza okugobwa mu nnyumba y'amaka?
question.sw: Mjane anaweza kufukuzwa kwenye nyumba ya familia?

en: Only if she has no children

explanation.en: The Succession Amendment Act 2022 gives the widow a share and protects her home. Section 7.
explanation.lg: Succession Amendment Act 2022 ewa nnamwandu ekitundu era ekuuma ennyumba ye. Section 7.
explanation.sw: Succession Amendment Act 2022 inampa mjane sehemu na kulinda nyumba yake. Kifungu cha 7.

question.en: Someone beats you at home. Where do you go?
question.lg: Omuntu akutwala ng'akukuba awaka. Ogenda wa?

en: Wait for him to calm down
lg: Ku CFPU ya Poliisi oba okubire 112

explanation.en: Domestic violence is a police matter, never LC1. Go to the Police CFPU or call 112 any time.
explanation.lg: Okukuba awaka musango gwa poliisi, si gwa LC1 n'akamu. Genda ku CFPU ya Poliisi oba okubire 112 essaawa yonna.
explanation.sw: Ukatili wa nyumbani ni shauri la polisi, kamwe si la LC1. Nenda CFPU ya Polisi au pigia 112 wakati wowote.

question.en: How much is the Mukono small business grant?
question.lg: Ensimbi za bizinensi entono mu Mukono mmeka?
question.sw: Ruzuku ya biashara ndogo Mukono ni pesa ngapi?

explanation.en: The Mukono small business grant is 500,000 UGX for registered businesses under 2 years. Forms are free.
explanation.lg: Ensimbi za bizinensi entono mu Mukono UGX 500,000 eri bizinensi ezawandiisibwa ezitakka myaka 2. Foomu za bwereere.
explanation.sw: Ruzuku ya biashara ndogo Mukono ni UGX 500,000 kwa biashara zilizosajiliwa chini ya miaka 2. Fomu ni bure.
